```{r setup}

source(here::here("libraries.R"))
```

```{r load raw data}

raw <- read.delim(here::here("data-raw/directDIA_Proteome_Report_Protein.tsv"), header = TRUE, na.strings = c("NaN"))

nrow(raw)
# 5558
ncol(raw)
# 169

# meta data
#Rename <- read_excel(here::here("data-raw/Rename.xlsx"))

```

```{r prepare raw data}

# name rows by unique gene name
raw$PG.Genes %>% duplicated() %>% any()
# TRUE
raw %>% group_by(PG.Genes) %>% summarize(frequency = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(frequency)) %>% filter(frequency > 1)
# Make unique names using the annotation in the "Gene.names" column as primary names and the annotation in "Protein.IDs" as name for those that do not have an gene name.
raw_unique <- make_unique(raw, "PG.Genes", "PG.UniProtIds", delim = ";")
raw_unique$name %>% duplicated() %>% any()
# FALSE
rownames(raw_unique) <- raw_unique$name


```

```{r QC raw data}

# detected proteins per sample
mat_raw <- as.matrix(raw_unique[, 6:169])
quanted_raw <- colSums(!is.na(mat_raw))
quanted_raw <- as.data.frame(quanted_raw)
average_proteins_per_sample <- quanted_raw %>%
    summarise(avg_sites = mean(quanted_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
              std_dev = sd(quanted_raw, na.rm = TRUE))
print(average_proteins_per_sample)
# avg_sites  std_dev
#  5283.232  +- 180.1825
ggplot(data = quanted_raw, aes(x = 1:164, y = quanted_raw)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "lightblue3") +
    labs(title = "Proteins per Sample", x = "Sample", y = "Proteins identified") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 40, hjust = 1)) +  # Adjust x axis text
    geom_hline(yintercept = average_proteins_per_sample$avg_sites,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "maroon3") +  # Add a dashed line for average
    geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = average_proteins_per_sample$avg_sites + 5),
              label = paste("Avg:", round(average_proteins_per_sample$avg_sites, 2)),
              color = "maroon4", vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0, size = 5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = average_proteins_per_sample$avg_sites - average_proteins_per_sample$std_dev - 10),
              label = paste("SD:", round(average_proteins_per_sample$std_dev, 2)),
              color = "blue", vjust = 1, hjust = 0, size = 5)

#"X.38..20231115_PRI_TIMS5_NEO4_X1285_P276_R1051_101min_DIA_S38_B.D2_1_8479.d.PG.Quantity" has a lot of missing values - remove this sample

column_to_remove <- c("X.38..20231115_PRI_TIMS5_NEO4_X1285_P276_R1051_101min_DIA_S38_B.D2_1_8479.d.PG.Quantity")
raw_unique_removedoutlier <- raw_unique[, !names(raw_unique) %in% column_to_remove, drop = FALSE]



################## FIGURE 1D ###########################

# compare proteins detected to previously published datasets
Hostrup2022 <- read_excel(here::here("data-raw/DetectedProteins_Hostrup2022.xlsx"))
Hingst2018 <- read_excel(here::here("data-raw/DetectedProteins_Hingst2018.xlsx"))

clean_genes <- function(genes) {
    gene_list <- unlist(strsplit(genes, ";"))
    clean_gene_list <- unique(gene_list[gene_list != ""])
        cleaned_genes <- paste(clean_gene_list, collapse = ";")
    return(cleaned_genes)
}

Hostrupcleaned <- Hostrup2022
Hostrupcleaned$Cleaned_Genes <- sapply(Hostrupcleaned$Genes, clean_genes)

Hingstcleaned <- Hingst2018
Hingstcleaned$Cleaned_Genes <- sapply(Hingstcleaned$PG.Genes, clean_genes)

genes_HIIT <- raw_unique_removedoutlier$PG.Genes
genes_Hostrup <- Hostrupcleaned$Cleaned_Genes
genes_Hingst <- Hingstcleaned$Cleaned_Genes

genes_HIIT_unique <- unique(genes_HIIT)
# 5551
genes_Hostrup_unique <- unique(genes_Hostrup)
# 3256
genes_Hingst_unique <- unique(genes_Hingst)
# 3269

Overlap_hostrup_hingst <- list(ThisStudy = genes_HIIT_unique,
                    Hostrup2022 = genes_Hostrup_unique,
                    Hingst2018 = genes_Hingst_unique)

venn_counts <- euler(Overlap_hostrup_hingst)
venn.plot <- plot(venn_counts, counts = TRUE, quantities = TRUE, main = "Overlap unique gene names", fills = c("purple", "grey", "white"))
print(venn.plot)

# Extract genes only in genes_HIIT_unique
genes_only_in_HIIT <- setdiff(genes_HIIT_unique, union(genes_Hostrup_unique, genes_Hingst_unique))
# 2078



####################### FIGURE 1E ##################################

# dynamic range plot highlighting genes only identified in this study
median_intensities <- apply(raw_unique_removedoutlier[, 6:168], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
rank_abundance <- rank(-median_intensities)
median_intensities_log10 <- log10(median_intensities)
dynamic_range <- data.frame(genes = rownames(raw_unique_removedoutlier), RankAbundance = rank_abundance, Log10MedianIntensity = median_intensities_log10)

dynamic_range <- dynamic_range %>%
    mutate(PointColor = ifelse(genes %in% genes_only_in_HIIT, "mediumpurple", "grey"))

label_high <- c("TTN", "MYH4",  "ACTB", "MYO1H", "CKM")
label_high_data <- list()
for (gene in label_high) {
    gene_subset <- dynamic_range[dynamic_range$genes == gene, ]
    label_high_data[[gene]] <- gene_subset
}
labels_high <- do.call(rbind, label_high_data)

label_low <- c("FOXO1", "SLU7", "POLR2C", "RNMT", "RBFOX2", "RBM38")

label_low_data <- list()
for (gene in label_low) {
    gene_subset <- dynamic_range[dynamic_range$genes == gene, ]
    label_low_data[[gene]] <- gene_subset
}
labels_low <- do.call(rbind, label_low_data)

dyn <- ggplot(dynamic_range, aes(x = RankAbundance, y = Log10MedianIntensity)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = PointColor), alpha = 0.3, shape = 21) +
    labs(x = "Protein Rank Abundance", y = "Log10 Median Intensity") +
    theme_classic() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(na.rm = TRUE)) +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = labels_high,
        aes(label = genes, color = PointColor),  
        size = 1.5,

        nudge_y = -0.5,

        max.overlaps = Inf,
        segment.size = 0.3,
        segment.alpha = 0.7,
        min.segment.length = unit(0, "lines")
    ) +

        text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 6),

####################### FIGURE 1F ###############################

# ORA of genes uniquely identified in this study
# universe genes:  all genes identified in all 3 studies
universe_genes <- union(union(genes_HIIT_unique, genes_Hostrup_unique), genes_Hingst_unique)
# 6006
universe_genes <- as.data.frame(universe_genes)
universe_genes$First_Value <- sapply(universe_genes$universe_genes, function(x) {
    first_value <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";"))[1]
    return(first_value)
})
universe_genes <- universe_genes[complete.cases(universe_genes$First_Value), ]

entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                                keys = universe_genes$First_Value,
                                column = "ENTREZID",
                                keytype = "SYMBOL")


# Add entrez IDs to the gene list
universe_genes <- universe_genes %>%
    mutate(entrez_id = entrez)
background_proteome <- universe_genes$entrez_id[!is.na(universe_genes$entrez_id) & universe_genes$entrez_id != ""]
background_proteome <- data.frame(background_proteome)

## genes only identified in HIIT study
df <- as.data.frame(genes_only_in_HIIT)
df$gene <- df$df
entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
                                keys = df$gene,
                                column = "ENTREZID",
                                keytype = "SYMBOL")
df <- df%>%
    dplyr::mutate(entrez_id=entrez)

# ORA
genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_CC <- enrichGO(
    df$entrez_id,
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "CC",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    universe = background_proteome,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    readable = FALSE,
    pool = FALSE
)
genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_CC_filtered <- clusterProfiler::simplify(genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_CC, cutoff=0.7, by="p.adjust", select_fun=min)

genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_BP <- enrichGO(
    df$entrez_id,
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    universe = background_proteome,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    readable = FALSE,
    pool = FALSE
)
genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_BP_filtered <- clusterProfiler::simplify(genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_BP, cutoff=0.7, by="p.adjust", select_fun=min)

genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_MF <- enrichGO(
    df$entrez_id,
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "MF",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    universe = background_proteome,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    readable = FALSE,
    pool = FALSE
)
genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_MF_filtered <- clusterProfiler::simplify(genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_MF, cutoff=0.7, by="p.adjust", select_fun=min)

# Combine results into a single dataframe
cc_df <- as.data.frame(genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_CC_filtered@result)
cc_df$Ontology <- "CC"
bp_df <- as.data.frame(genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_BP_filtered@result)
bp_df$Ontology <- "BP"
mf_df <- as.data.frame(genes_only_in_HIIT_ORA_MF_filtered@result)
mf_df$Ontology <- "MF"
combined_df <- bind_rows(cc_df, bp_df, mf_df)

# Convert GeneRatio from fraction to numeric
combined_df$GeneRatio <- sapply(combined_df$GeneRatio, function(x) {
    eval(parse(text = x))
})

# Filter to retain only the top 10 categories for each ontology
top_n_per_ontology <- combined_df %>%
    group_by(Ontology) %>%
    top_n(n = 3, wt = Count) %>%
    ungroup()

## based on lowest p-value
top_n_per_ontology <- combined_df %>%
    group_by(Ontology) %>%
    top_n(n = 3, wt = -p.adjust) %>%
    ungroup()
gene_ratio_breaks <- pretty(top_n_per_ontology$GeneRatio, n = 5)
dotplot_combined <- ggplot(top_n_per_ontology, aes(x = GeneRatio, y = Description, size = Count, color = p.adjust)) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_grid(Ontology ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "paleturquoise3", high = "mediumpurple3", name = "p.adjust") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Count") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = gene_ratio_breaks, labels = scales::comma_format()) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),  # Font size for facet labels
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6),  # Font size for x-axis title
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 0),  # Font size for y-axis title
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),  # Font size for x-axis text
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),  # Font size for y-axis text
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Font size for legend text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6)  # Font size for legend title
    )
```

```{r raw data - rename columns}

# rename columns
print(colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier))
raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed <- raw_unique_removedoutlier
print(colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed))
names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)[6:168] <- substr(names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)[6:168], 58, 70)
print(colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed))
sample_names <- str_extract(names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed), "S[0-9]+")
names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)[6:168] <- sample_names[6:168]
print(colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed))
setdiff(Rename$AnalyticalSampleID, names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed))
for (i in 1:nrow(Rename)) {
    current_col_title <- Rename$AnalyticalSampleID[i]
    additional_info <- Rename$Sample_ID[i]
    if (current_col_title %in% names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)) {
        names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)[which(names(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed) == current_col_title)] <- additional_info
    }
}
print(colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed))

### reorder columns
# Ensure Rename$Sample_ID is a character vector
Rename$Sample_ID <- as.character(Rename$Sample_ID)

# Extract column names of log2_rename (from column 6 to 168)
raw_colnames <- colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)[6:168]

# Identify matching columns and reorder
matched_cols <- intersect(Rename$Sample_ID, raw_colnames)

# Ensure all columns are found
if (length(matched_cols) != length(Rename$Sample_ID)) {
    warning("Some columns in Rename$Sample_ID were not found in raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed")
}

# Reorder only if all columns are matched
if (length(matched_cols) == length(Rename$Sample_ID)) {
    raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed <- raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed[, c(1:5, match(Rename$Sample_ID, colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed)))]
}

print(colnames(raw_unique_removedoutlier_renamed))


```


```{r log2 transform data}

# convert NA's and log2 transform the sample columns
log2 <- raw_unique_removedoutlier
log2[, 6:168] <- apply(raw_unique_removedoutlier[, 6:168], 2, function(x) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    ifelse(!is.na(x) & x > 0, log2(x), NA)})


```


```{r log 2- Rename columns}

# rename columns
print(colnames(log2))
log2_renamed2 <- log2
print(colnames(log2_renamed2))
names(log2_renamed2)[6:168] <- substr(names(log2_renamed2)[6:168], 58, 70)
print(colnames(log2_renamed2))
sample_names <- str_extract(names(log2_renamed2), "S[0-9]+")
names(log2_renamed2)[6:168] <- sample_names[6:168]
print(colnames(log2_renamed2))
setdiff(Rename$AnalyticalSampleID, names(log2_renamed2))
for (i in 1:nrow(Rename)) {
    current_col_title <- Rename$AnalyticalSampleID[i]
    additional_info <- Rename$Sample_ID[i]
    if (current_col_title %in% names(log2_renamed2)) {
        names(log2_renamed2)[which(names(log2_renamed2) == current_col_title)] <- additional_info
    }
}
print(colnames(log2_renamed2))
log2_renamed <- log2_renamed2
print(colnames(log2_renamed))


### reorder columns
# Ensure Rename$Sample_ID is a character vector
Rename$Sample_ID <- as.character(Rename$Sample_ID)

# Extract column names of log2_rename (from column 6 to 168)
log2_colnames <- colnames(log2_renamed)[6:168]

# Identify matching columns and reorder
matched_cols <- intersect(Rename$Sample_ID, log2_colnames)

# Ensure all columns are found
if (length(matched_cols) != length(Rename$Sample_ID)) {
    warning("Some columns in Rename$Sample_ID were not found in log2_rename")
}

# Reorder only if all columns are matched
if (length(matched_cols) == length(Rename$Sample_ID)) {
    log2_renamed <- log2_renamed[, c(1:5, match(Rename$Sample_ID, colnames(log2_renamed)))]
}

# Print to verify
print(colnames(log2_renamed)[6:168])



```


```{r QC log2 data}

# check normality
samples_log2 <- log2_renamed[, 6:168]
graphics::boxplot(samples_log2)



###################### FIGURE 1G ###############################

# variability in log2 data: CV plot
data <- samples_log2
cv_log2 <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(coefficient_variation = apply(data,
                                                1,
                                                FUN = function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mean_LFQ = rowMeans(data, na.rm = TRUE))
median_cv <- median(cv_log2$coefficient_variation, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_cv <- mean(cv_log2$coefficient_variation, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Median CV:", median_cv, "\n")
# Median CV: 4.523731
cat("Mean CV:", mean_cv, "\n")
# Mean CV: 6.081578 

data_plot <- cv_log2 |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene.name") |>
    dplyr::mutate(perc_CVs = dplyr::case_when(
        coefficient_variation <= 4.523731  ~ "under_median",
        TRUE ~ "over_mean"
    ))


#table(data_plot$perc_CVs)
#   over_mean under_mean
#      1888       3670 

cv <- data_plot |>
    ggplot2::ggplot(
        ggplot2::aes(x = mean_LFQ,
                     y = coefficient_variation,
                     color = perc_CVs)
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.5,
                        alpha = 1,
                        na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
        values = c("dodgerblue4",
                   "deepskyblue3")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 25), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "text",
        x = 20,
        y = 9,
        fontface = 1.5,
        label = "Median %CV = 4.52",
        size = 2
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
        yintercept = 4.52,
        linetype = "dotted",
        colour = "black",
        size = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::ylab("Mean coefficient of variation (%)") +
    ggplot2::xlab("Mean Log2 intensities") +
    ggplot2::theme(
        text = ggplot2::element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size = 8),
        legend.position = "none",
    )

cv



################# FIGURE S1C ##################

df <- rownames_log2_removed_outlier_renamed[, 6:168]
colnames(df) <- Rename$label

df_complete <- df[complete.cases(df), ]

Rename_order <- Rename

Rename_order$Combined <- factor(Rename_order$Combined, levels = c("LeanPreBasal", "LeanPreInsulin", "ObesePreBasal", "ObesePreInsulin", "T2DPreBasal", "T2DPreInsulin", "LeanPostBasal", "LeanPostInsulin", "ObesePostBasal", "ObesePostInsulin", "T2DPostBasal", "T2DPostInsulin"))

order_indices <- order(Rename_order$Combined[match(colnames(df_complete), Rename_order$label)])
df_complete_ordered <- df_complete[, order_indices]

correlation_matrix <- cor(df_complete_ordered, method = "pearson")

# Annotations
Rename_order$Group <- ifelse(Rename_order$Group == "Lean", 1, ifelse(Rename_order$Group == "Obese", 2, ifelse(Rename_order$Group == "T2D", 3, Rename_order$Group)))
Rename_order$Group <- as.numeric(Rename_order$Group)
annotation_group <- data.frame(Group = Rename_order$Group)
rownames(annotation_group) <- Rename_order$label

Rename_order$Timepoint <- ifelse(Rename_order$Timepoint == "Pre", 1, ifelse(Rename_order$Timepoint == "Post", 2, Rename_order$Timepoint))
Rename_order$Timepoint <- as.numeric(Rename_order$Timepoint)
annotation_timepoint <- data.frame(Timepoint = Rename_order$Timepoint)
rownames(annotation_timepoint) <- Rename_order$label

Rename_order$Condition <- ifelse(Rename_order$Condition == "Basal", 1, ifelse(Rename_order$Condition == "Insulin", 2, Rename_order$Condition))
Rename_order$Condition <- as.numeric(Rename_order$Condition)
annotation_condition <- data.frame(Condition = Rename_order$Condition)
rownames(annotation_condition) <- Rename_order$label

annotation_col <- data.frame(
    Timepoint = annotation_timepoint,
    Group = annotation_group,
    Condition = annotation_condition)

pheatmap(correlation_matrix,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("pink3" ,"lightpink1", "lightpink", "mistyrose", "white", "lightcyan", "lightskyblue1", "darkslateblue"))(100),
         main = "Pearson Correlation Heatmap",
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         scale = "none",
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = list(
             Timepoint = c("1" = "plum1", "2" = "palegreen3"),
             Group = c("1" = "deepskyblue4", "2" = "purple4", "3" = "maroon3"),
             Condition = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red")
         ),
         breaks = seq(0.75, 1, length.out = 100))


# exclude diagonal elements
correlation_values <- correlation_matrix[upper.tri(correlation_matrix)]

# statistics
min_corr <- min(correlation_values)
max_corr <- max(correlation_values)
median_corr <- median(correlation_values)
mean_corr <- mean(correlation_values)

print(paste("Minimum correlation:", min_corr))
# "Minimum correlation: 0.935715872933297"
print(paste("Maximum correlation:", max_corr))
```

```{r Main_Effect_Volcanos}
# Volcano training main effect

# Count significantly upregulated and downregulated genes
upregulated_count <- sum(table_MainEffect_Training$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & table_MainEffect_Training$logFC > 0)
downregulated_count <- sum(table_MainEffect_Training$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & table_MainEffect_Training$logFC < 0)

# Output the counts
cat("Number of significantly upregulated proteins with training:", upregulated_count, "\n")
# 432
cat("Number of significantly downregulated proteins with training:", downregulated_count, "\n")
# 330


volcano_training <- function(.data) {
    if("Protein" %in% colnames(.data)) {
        data_volcano <- .data
    } else {
        data_volcano <- .data %>%
            rownames_to_column("Protein")
    }

    data_volcano <- data_volcano %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            significant = dplyr::case_when(
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "significantly upregulated",
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "significantly downregulated",
                TRUE ~ "not significant"
            )
        )

    p <- ggplot(data_volcano, aes(
        x = logFC,
        y = -log10(P.Value),
        color = significant,
        label = Protein
    )) +
        geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c(
            "not significant" = "grey",
            "significantly downregulated" = "dodgerblue4",
            "significantly upregulated" = "firebrick4"
        ), name = "Significantly different") +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
            text = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
            legend.position = "none"
        )

    labels_to_show <- c(
        "CD93","HK2", "PSMA4", "SLC2A4", "MYLK2", "COX2", "BCKDK", "PDK2", "MRPS15", "DEPTOR", "PRKAG2", "PRKAA1", "PRKAG3"

    )

    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = dplyr::filter(data_volcano, Protein %in% labels_to_show),
        aes(
            x = logFC,
            y = -log10(P.Value),
            label = Protein,
            color = significant
        ),
        size = 1.5,
        min.segment.length = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        segment.size = unit(0.2, "mm"),
        segment.color = "grey30",
        force = 70,
        max.overlaps = Inf
    ) + scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "not significant" = "grey",
        "significantly downregulated" = "dodgerblue4",
        "significantly upregulated" = "firebrick4"
    ))

    return(p)
}
```

```{r Specific_Contrast}
# Define a function to extract the full table and count significant hits for a given comparison
extract_and_store_full_table <- function(fit, comparison_name, p_value_threshold = 0.05) {
    full_table <- limma::topTable(fit,
                                  coef = comparison_name,
                                  adjust = "BH",
                                  number = Inf)
    full_table$Protein <- rownames(full_table)
    significant_table <- full_table[full_table$adj.P.Val < p_value_threshold, ]
    significant_table <- na.omit(significant_table)
    cat("Comparison:", comparison_name, " - Number of significant hits:", nrow(significant_table), "\n")
    assign(paste0(comparison_name), full_table, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    return(nrow(significant_table))
}

                 "Obese_Lean_prebasal", "Obese_Lean_preinsulin", 
                 "Obese_Lean_postbasal", "Obese_Lean_postinsulin", 
                 "Lean_trainingBasal", "Lean_trainingInsulin", 
                 "Obese_trainingBasal", "Obese_trainingInsulin", 
                 "T2D_trainingBasal", "T2D_trainingInsulin", 
                 "Lean_clamp_pre", "Lean_clamp_post", 
                 "Obese_clamp_pre", "Obese_clamp_post", 
                 "T2D_clamp_pre", "T2D_clamp_post")

for (comparison in comparisons) {
```

```{r Group comparisons - intra-group variability of proteins diff at baseline (raw p<0.05)}


######################## FIGURE S2A #################################


# Step 1: Collect all significant proteins from the pre-training basal comparisons
sig_proteins_pre_basal <- unique(c(
  T2D_Lean_prebasal %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>% pull(Protein),
  T2D_Obese_prebasal %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>% pull(Protein),
  Obese_Lean_prebasal %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>% pull(Protein)
))
# 953

# Step 2: Extract expression matrix for Basal Pre samples only
pre_basal_samples <- Rename %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "Pre", Condition == "Basal")
# Ensure Sample_IDs are characters to match colnames
pre_basal_samples$Sample_ID <- as.character(pre_basal_samples$Sample_ID)

# Also ensure column names are characters (they should be by default)
colnames(proteome_dataset) <- as.character(colnames(proteome_dataset))

# Now subset
pre_basal_expr <- proteome_dataset[, pre_basal_samples$Sample_ID]

# Subset the matrix to only include significant proteins
pre_basal_expr_sig <- pre_basal_expr[rownames(pre_basal_expr) %in% sig_proteins_pre_basal, ]

# Step 3: Add group information
group_info <- data.frame(
  Sample_ID = pre_basal_samples$Sample_ID,
  Group = pre_basal_samples$Group
)

# Step 4: Transpose for easy manipulation (samples as rows, proteins as columns)
expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(pre_basal_expr_sig))
expr_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(expr_df)

# Add group labels
expr_df <- left_join(expr_df, group_info, by = "Sample_ID")

# Step 5: Reshape and compute SD per protein per group

expr_long <- expr_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sig_proteins_pre_basal), names_to = "Protein", values_to = "Expression")

# Calculate standard deviation within each group for each protein
intragroup_sd <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(Group, Protein) %>%
  summarise(SD = sd(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")




# Compute group-wise summary stats
group_sd_summary <- intragroup_sd %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_SD = mean(SD, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_SD = median(SD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


print(group_sd_summary)

plot_intragroup_sd <- ggplot(intragroup_sd, aes(x = Group, y = SD)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.05, aes(color = Group)) +
  geom_text(data = group_sd_summary,
            aes(x = Group, y = max(intragroup_sd$SD, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
                label = paste0("Mean: ", round(mean_SD, 2), "\nMedian: ", round(median_SD, 2))),
            size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lean" = "deepskyblue4", "Obese" = "purple4", "T2D" = "maroon3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Intra-group variability (SD) of significantly regulated Pre-Basal proteins",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Standard Deviation (per protein)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )

plot_intragroup_sd

ggsave(plot = plot_intragroup_sd,
       filename = here::here("doc/intragroup_SD_p0.05.pdf"),
       units = "mm",
       height = 60,
       width = 25)

############## statistics

# Reshape to wide format (each protein = one row, groups = columns)
sd_wide <- intragroup_sd %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = SD)

# Compute paired differences
sd_wide <- sd_wide %>%
  mutate(
    diff_T2D_Lean = T2D - Lean,
    diff_T2D_Obese = T2D - Obese,
    diff_Obese_Lean = Obese - Lean
  )

# Shapiro-Wilk normality checks
shapiro.test(sd_wide$diff_T2D_Lean)     # p = 0.91 → normal
shapiro.test(sd_wide$diff_Obese_Lean)   # p = 0.037 → not normal
shapiro.test(sd_wide$diff_T2D_Obese)    # p = 3.3e-06 → not normal

# Use Wilcoxon signed-rank test for all (consistent approach)
wilcox_T2D_vs_Lean <- wilcox.test(sd_wide$T2D, sd_wide$Lean, paired = TRUE)
wilcox_Obese_vs_Lean <- wilcox.test(sd_wide$Obese, sd_wide$Lean, paired = TRUE)
wilcox_T2D_vs_Obese <- wilcox.test(sd_wide$T2D, sd_wide$Obese, paired = TRUE)

# Print test results
print(wilcox_T2D_vs_Lean)
print(wilcox_Obese_vs_Lean)
print(wilcox_T2D_vs_Obese)
```

```{r ORA training specific per group}



# Define lists for upregulated proteins
upregulated <- list(
  Lean = Lean_trainingBasal$Protein[Lean_trainingBasal$logFC > 0 & Lean_trainingBasal$adj.P.Val < 0.05],
  Obese = Obese_trainingBasal$Protein[Obese_trainingBasal$logFC > 0 & Obese_trainingBasal$adj.P.Val < 0.05],
  T2D = T2D_trainingBasal$Protein[T2D_trainingBasal$logFC > 0 & T2D_trainingBasal$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
)

# Extract uniquely upregulated proteins
unique_upregulated <- list(
  Lean = setdiff(upregulated$Lean, c(upregulated$Obese, upregulated$T2D)),
  Obese = setdiff(upregulated$Obese, c(upregulated$Lean, upregulated$T2D)),
  T2D = setdiff(upregulated$T2D, c(upregulated$Lean, upregulated$Obese))
)

# Define lists for downregulated proteins
downregulated <- list(
  Lean = Lean_trainingBasal$Protein[Lean_trainingBasal$logFC < 0 & Lean_trainingBasal$adj.P.Val < 0.05],
  Obese = Obese_trainingBasal$Protein[Obese_trainingBasal$logFC < 0 & Obese_trainingBasal$adj.P.Val < 0.05],
  T2D = T2D_trainingBasal$Protein[T2D_trainingBasal$logFC < 0 & T2D_trainingBasal$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
)

# Extract uniquely downregulated proteins
unique_downregulated <- list(
  Lean = setdiff(downregulated$Lean, c(downregulated$Obese, downregulated$T2D)),
  Obese = setdiff(downregulated$Obese, c(downregulated$Lean, downregulated$T2D)),
  T2D = setdiff(downregulated$T2D, c(downregulated$Lean, downregulated$Obese))
)


# ORA
perform_ORA <- function(gene_list, universe_genes, ontology = "ALL") {
  if (length(gene_list) == 0) return(NULL)  # Skip if list is empty

  # Convert to Entrez IDs
  entrez_genes <- bitr(gene_list, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
  entrez_universe <- bitr(universe_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

  # Run ORA
  enrich_res <- enrichGO(
    gene          = entrez_genes$ENTREZID,
    universe      = entrez_universe$ENTREZID,
    OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",
    ont           = ontology,  # "BP" for Biological Process
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    readable      = TRUE
  )

  return(enrich_res)
}

# Define gene universe (all detected proteins)
gene_universe <- unique(c(Lean_trainingBasal$Protein, Obese_trainingBasal$Protein, T2D_trainingBasal$Protein))

# Perform ORA for uniquely upregulated proteins
ora_upregulated <- list(
  Lean = perform_ORA(unique_upregulated$Lean, gene_universe),
  Obese = perform_ORA(unique_upregulated$Obese, gene_universe),
  T2D = perform_ORA(unique_upregulated$T2D, gene_universe)
)

# Perform ORA for uniquely downregulated proteins
ora_downregulated <- list(
  Lean = perform_ORA(unique_downregulated$Lean, gene_universe),
  Obese = perform_ORA(unique_downregulated$Obese, gene_universe),
  T2D = perform_ORA(unique_downregulated$T2D, gene_universe)
)

# 

# Function to extract ORA results as a dataframe
extract_ora_df <- function(ora_result) {
  if (is.null(ora_result)) return(NULL)  # Skip if no enrichment

  df <- as.data.frame(ora_result)
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)  # Skip if no significant terms

  # Extract necessary columns
  df_filtered <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, GeneRatio, p.adjust, Count) %>%
    mutate(GeneRatio = as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", GeneRatio)) / as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", GeneRatio)))  # Convert GeneRatio to numeric

  return(df_filtered)
}

# Extract data for each ORA result
ora_up_lean_df <- extract_ora_df(ora_upregulated$Lean)
ora_up_obese_df <- extract_ora_df(ora_upregulated$Obese)
ora_up_t2d_df <- extract_ora_df(ora_upregulated$T2D)

ora_down_lean_df <- extract_ora_df(ora_downregulated$Lean)
ora_down_obese_df <- extract_ora_df(ora_downregulated$Obese)
ora_down_t2d_df <- extract_ora_df(ora_downregulated$T2D)

# Function to plot ORA results using ggplot
plot_ORA_ggplot <- function(ora_df, title) {
  if (is.null(ora_df)) {
    print(paste(title, "- No enriched GO terms"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  ggplot(ora_df, aes(x = GeneRatio, y = reorder(Description, GeneRatio), size = Count, color = p.adjust)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "paleturquoise3", high = "mediumpurple3", name = "p.adjust") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Count") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),  
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),  
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 6),  
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),  
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6), 
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6)  
    ) +
    labs(title = title)
}

# Plot results
plot_ORA_ggplot(ora_up_lean_df, "ORA - Uniquely Upregulated in Lean")
# NONE
plot_ORA_ggplot(ora_up_obese_df, "ORA - Uniquely Upregulated in Obese")
plot_ORA_ggplot(ora_up_t2d_df, "ORA - Uniquely Upregulated in T2D")

plot_ORA_ggplot(ora_down_lean_df, "ORA - Uniquely Downregulated in Lean")
plot_ORA_ggplot(ora_down_obese_df, "ORA - Uniquely Downregulated in Obese")
plot_ORA_ggplot(ora_down_t2d_df, "ORA - Uniquely Downregulated in T2D")
```

```{r T2D group comparison vs training}
  by = "Protein", 
  suffixes = c("_T2DTraining", "_T2DLean")
)

# Define color based on significance
plot_data$color <- ifelse(
  plot_data$adj.P.Val_T2DTraining < 0.05 & plot_data$adj.P.Val_T2DLean < 0.1, "blue4",  # Both conditions met
  ifelse(
    plot_data$adj.P.Val_T2DTraining < 0.05, "magenta3",  # Only T2DTraining is significant
    ifelse(plot_data$adj.P.Val_T2DLean < 0.1, "deepskyblue3", "grey")  # Only T2DLean is significant
  )
)

# Generate the plot
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = logFC_T2DTraining, y = logFC_T2DLean, color = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_identity() +  # Uses the assigned colors directly
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "T2D Training and T2D-Lean (Pre-Basal)",
    x = "logFC(Post - Pre, T2D)",
    y = "logFC(T2D - Lean, baseline)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
p

# pearson correlation coefficient
correlation_result <- cor.test(plot_data$logFC_T2DTraining, plot_data$logFC_T2DLean, 
                               use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")

print(correlation_result)
```

```{r Volcanos specific contrasts}


######################### FIGURE 3A ###############################

volcano_trainingGroup <- function(.data, x_limits = c(-2.5, 3), y_limits = c(0, 8)) {
    if("Protein" %in% colnames(.data)) {
        data_volcano <- .data
    } else {
        data_volcano <- .data %>%
            rownames_to_column("Protein")
    }

    data_volcano <- data_volcano %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            significant = dplyr::case_when(
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "significantly upregulated",
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "significantly downregulated",
               # adj.P.Val >= 0.05 & adj.P.Val < 0.1 & logFC > 0 ~ "marginally up",
                #adj.P.Val >= 0.05 & adj.P.Val < 0.1 & logFC < 0 ~ "marginally down",
                TRUE ~ "not significant"
            )
        )

    p <- ggplot(data_volcano, aes(
        x = logFC,
        y = -log10(P.Value),
        color = significant,
        label = Protein
    )) +
        geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c(
            "not significant" = "grey",
           # "marginally up" = "indianred3",
            #"marginally down" = "skyblue3",
            "significantly downregulated" = "dodgerblue4",
            "significantly upregulated" = "firebrick4"
        ), name = "Significance") +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
            text = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
            legend.position = "none"
        ) +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits)

    labels_to_show <- c(
        "CMBL", "CD93", "OTUD6B", "PDLIM3", "PRKAG2", "SYNPO2L", "PXDN", "FLNB", "H1-5", "PRKAR2A"
        #  "PSMA4", "MYLK2", "PRKAG2", "PRKAA1", "PKRAG3", "CASTOR2", "CD93", "MRPS15",  "SYNPOL", "PRKAR2A", "ECPAS"
    )

    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = dplyr::filter(data_volcano, Protein %in% labels_to_show),
        aes(
            x = logFC,
            y = -log10(P.Value),
            label = Protein,
            color = significant
        ),
        size = 2,
        min.segment.length = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        segment.size = unit(0.2, "mm"),
        segment.color = "grey30",
        force = 80,
        max.overlaps = Inf
    )

    return(p)
}



v_lean <- volcano_trainingGroup(Lean_trainingBasal)
v_obese <- volcano_trainingGroup(Obese_trainingBasal)
v_t2d <- volcano_trainingGroup(T2D_trainingBasal)

v <- v_lean + v_obese + v_t2d
v
```

```{r absolute logFC vs SD(abs.logFC) for specific training effects}


################### FIGURE 3C and FIGURE S3B ##################################

# Step 1: Keep only Basal samples
Rename_basal <- Rename %>% filter(Condition == "Basal")
columns_keep <- intersect(colnames(samples_log2_removedoutlier_renamed_filter50_median_BeatboxBatchcorrected_df), Rename_basal$Sample_ID)
basal <- samples_log2_removedoutlier_renamed_filter50_median_BeatboxBatchcorrected_df[, columns_keep]

# Step 2: Define significant proteins
lean_training <- Lean_trainingBasal %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% pull(Protein)
obese_training <- Obese_trainingBasal %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% pull(Protein)
t2d_training <- T2D_trainingBasal %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% pull(Protein)
any_sig_training <- unique(c(lean_training, obese_training, t2d_training))

# Step 3: Calculate logFC (Post - Pre) per participant
logFC_df <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(basal))

for (Participant in unique(Rename_basal$Participant)) {
    pre_sample <- Rename_basal$Sample_ID[Rename_basal$Participant == Participant & Rename_basal$Timepoint == "Pre"]
    post_sample <- Rename_basal$Sample_ID[Rename_basal$Participant == Participant & Rename_basal$Timepoint == "Post"]
    
    if (length(pre_sample) == 1 && length(post_sample) == 1 &&
        pre_sample %in% colnames(basal) && post_sample %in% colnames(basal)) {
        
        logFC_values <- basal[, colnames(basal) %in% post_sample] - basal[, colnames(basal) %in% pre_sample]
        logFC_df[[as.character(Participant)]] <- logFC_values
    } else {
        message("Skipping participant ", Participant, " due to missing Pre/Post samples.")
    }
}

# Step 4: Transpose and add group info
logFC_df <- t(logFC_df)
logFC_df <- as.data.frame(logFC_df)
logFC_df$Group <- Rename_basal$Group[match(rownames(logFC_df), Rename_basal$Participant)]

# Step 5: Convert to absolute logFC
logFC_abs_df <- logFC_df
logFC_abs_df[, -ncol(logFC_abs_df)] <- abs(logFC_abs_df[, -ncol(logFC_abs_df)])

# Step 6: Calculate mean and SD of absolute logFC per group
mean_sd_results <- data.frame(Protein = colnames(logFC_abs_df)[-ncol(logFC_abs_df)])
for (group in unique(logFC_abs_df$Group)) {
    group_data <- logFC_abs_df[logFC_abs_df$Group == group, -ncol(logFC_abs_df)]
    mean_values <- apply(group_data, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_values <- apply(group_data, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_sd_results[[paste0(group, "_Mean")]] <- mean_values
    mean_sd_results[[paste0(group, "_SD")]] <- sd_values
}

# Step 7: Filter to significant proteins only
mean_sd_results <- mean_sd_results %>% filter(Protein %in% any_sig_training)

# Step 8: Reshape to long format for plotting
mean_sd_long <- mean_sd_results %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Protein, names_to = "Measure", values_to = "Value") %>%
    separate(Measure, into = c("Group", "Metric"), sep = "_") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Value)

# Step 9: Add color coding by significance
mean_sd_long <- mean_sd_long %>%
    mutate(
        Color = case_when(
            Group == "Lean" & Protein %in% lean_training ~ "deepskyblue3",
            Group == "Obese" & Protein %in% obese_training ~ "mediumpurple4",
            Group == "T2D" & Protein %in% t2d_training ~ "magenta3",
            TRUE ~ "grey"
        )
    )

# Step 10: Plot SD vs. Mean(abs(logFC))
logFC_abs_plot <- ggplot(mean_sd_long, aes(x = SD, y = Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Color), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ Group, scales = "fixed") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
        title = "SD vs. Mean(abs(logFC Post-Pre)) for sig. training-reg proteins",
        x = "Standard Deviation of abs(logFC)",
        y = "Mean abs(logFC)"
    ) +
    theme(
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6)
    )
print(logFC_abs_plot)

# Step 11: Compute groupwise summaries
logFC_mean_long <- logFC_abs_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Group, names_to = "Protein", values_to = "abs_logFC") %>%
    group_by(Group, Protein) %>%
    summarise(abs_logFC = mean(abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(Protein %in% any_sig_training)

logFC_sd_long <- logFC_abs_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Group, names_to = "Protein", values_to = "abs_logFC") %>%
    group_by(Group, Protein) %>%
    summarise(SD = sd(abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(Protein %in% any_sig_training)

# Step 12: Summary stats
logFC_mean_summary <- logFC_mean_long %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
        Mean_abs_logFC = mean(abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median_abs_logFC = median(abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

logFC_sd_summary <- logFC_sd_long %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
        Mean_SD_abs_logFC = mean(SD, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median_SD_abs_logFC = median(SD, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

print(logFC_mean_summary)
print(logFC_sd_summary)

# Step 13: Wilcoxon tests
logFC_mean_wide <- mean_sd_long %>%
    dplyr::select(Group, Protein, Mean) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Mean)

logFC_sd_wide <- mean_sd_long %>%
    dplyr::select(Group, Protein, SD) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = SD)

wilcox.test(logFC_mean_wide$T2D, logFC_mean_wide$Lean, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(logFC_mean_wide$T2D, logFC_mean_wide$Obese, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(logFC_mean_wide$Obese, logFC_mean_wide$Lean, paired = TRUE)

wilcox.test(logFC_sd_wide$T2D, logFC_sd_wide$Lean, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(logFC_sd_wide$T2D, logFC_sd_wide$Obese, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(logFC_sd_wide$Obese, logFC_sd_wide$Lean, paired = TRUE)








# Final Plot Using Real logFC

# Recalculate mean(logFC) per group using the original logFC_df
logFC_real_long <- logFC_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Group, names_to = "Protein", values_to = "logFC") %>%

    summarise(Mean_logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%

# Merge real mean(logFC) and SD(abs(logFC))
real_logFC_plot_data <- left_join(logFC_real_long, logFC_sd_abs_long, by = c("Group", "Protein"))

# Add color coding

    mutate(
        Color = case_when(

# Plot
```

```{r boxplots}
prebasal_plot <- function(protein_name) {
    protein_row <- samples_log2_removedoutlier_renamed_filter50_median_BeatboxBatchcorrected_df[protein_name, , drop = FALSE]
    protein_row_t <- t(protein_row)
    protein_row_t <- as.data.frame(protein_row_t)

    # Add metadata
    protein_row_t$GroupTimepoint <- Rename$GroupTimepoint
    protein_row_t$Sample <- Rename$Sample_ID
    protein_row_t$Group <- Rename$Group
    protein_row_t$Timepoint <- Rename$Timepoint
    protein_row_t$Condition <- Rename$Condition
    protein_row_t$Participant <- Rename$Participant

    # Filter to include only "Pre" samples
    protein_row_t <- protein_row_t %>%
        filter(grepl("Pre", GroupTimepoint) & Condition == "Basal")

    # Ensure correct factor levels for GroupTimepoint
    protein_row_t$GroupTimepoint <- factor(protein_row_t$GroupTimepoint, levels = c("LeanPre", "ObesePre", "T2DPre"))

    # Define custom colors
    color_fill <- c("Pre" = "white")
    color_groups <- c("Lean" = "deepskyblue4", "Obese" = "purple4", "T2D" = "maroon3")

    point_size <- 0.1
    line_size <- 0.3
    fatten_median <- 0.8

    plot <- ggplot(protein_row_t, aes(x = GroupTimepoint, y = !!sym(protein_name), color = Group, fill = Timepoint)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = point_size, size = line_size, fatten = fatten_median) + # Adjust box and median line size
        geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.5, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
        labs(title = paste(protein_name), x = "", y = "log2 expression") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
        scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
            legend.position = "none",
            axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
        )
    return(plot)
}


boxplot_pre_post <- function(protein_name) {
    protein_row <- proteome_dataset[protein_name, , drop = FALSE]
    protein_row_t <- t(protein_row)
    protein_row_t <- as.data.frame(protein_row_t)
    protein_row_t$GroupTimepoint <- Rename$GroupTimepoint
    protein_row_t$GroupTimepoint <- factor(protein_row_t$GroupTimepoint, levels = c("LeanPre", "LeanPost", "ObesePre", "ObesePost", "T2DPre", "T2DPost"))
    protein_row_t$Sample <- Rename$Sample_ID
    protein_row_t$Group <- Rename$Group
    protein_row_t$Timepoint <- Rename$Timepoint
    protein_row_t$Participant <- Rename$Participant
    protein_row_t$Condition <- Rename$Condition
    # Filter to include only "Pre" samples
    protein_row_t <- protein_row_t %>% filter(grepl("Basal", Condition))

    # Define custom colors
    color_fill <- c("Pre" = "white", "Post" = "mistyrose")
    color_groups <- c("Lean" = "deepskyblue4", "Obese" = "purple4", "T2D" = "maroon3")

    point_size <- 0.01
    line_size <- 0.2
    fatten_median <- 0.8

    plot <- ggplot(protein_row_t, aes(x = GroupTimepoint, y = !!sym(protein_name), color = Group, fill = Timepoint)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01, size = line_size, fatten = fatten_median) +
        geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.2, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
        geom_line(aes(group = Participant, colour = Group), size = 0.1, alpha=0.5) +
        labs(title = paste(protein_name), x = "", y = "") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
        scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
            legend.position = "none",
            axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
        )
    return(plot)
}

boxplots_all <- function(Sites, data, Info) {
    plots_list <- list() 
    
    for (site_name in Sites) {

        site_row <- data[site_name, , drop = FALSE]
        site_row_t <- t(site_row)  
        site_row_t <- as.data.frame(site_row_t)

        site_row_t$Combined <- Rename$Combined
        site_row_t$Rename <- factor(site_row_t$Combined, levels = c(
            "LeanPreBasal", "LeanPreInsulin", "LeanPostBasal", "LeanPostInsulin",
            "ObesePreBasal", "ObesePreInsulin", "ObesePostBasal", "ObesePostInsulin",
            "T2DPreBasal", "T2DPreInsulin", "T2DPostBasal", "T2DPostInsulin"
        ))
        site_row_t$Group <- Rename$Group
        site_row_t$Timepoint <- Rename$Timepoint
        site_row_t$Participant <- Rename$Participant
        site_row_t$Condition <- Rename$Condition


        color_fill <- c("Pre" = "white", "Post" = "mistyrose1")
        color_groups <- c("Lean" = "deepskyblue4", "Obese" = "purple4", "T2D" = "maroon3")

        point_size <- 0.05
        line_size <- 0.2
        fatten_median <- 0.8

        plot <- ggplot(site_row_t, aes(x = Rename, y = !!sym(site_name), color = Group, fill = Timepoint)) +
            geom_boxplot(outlier.size = point_size, size = line_size, fatten = fatten_median) +
            geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
            geom_line(aes(group = Participant, colour = Group), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
            labs(title = paste("", site_name)) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
            scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
            theme_classic() +
            theme(
                legend.position = "none",
                text = element_text(size = 6),
                axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
            )
        
        plots_list[[site_name]] <- plot
    }

    combined_plots <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots_list, ncol = 1))

    return(combined_plots)
}

sites <- c("")

plots <- boxplots_all(Sites = sites, data = proteome_dataset, Info = Rename)
```

```{r Prepare_GSEA}
prepare_gsea_list <- function(topTable_data) {
  topTable_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(logFC)) %>%
```

```{r GSEA}

gsea <- function(gene_list, OrgDb, ont = "ALL", pvalue_cutoff = 0.05, key_type = "SYMBOL", n_perm_simple = 100000, eps = 0, simplify_cutoff = 0.7) {
  gsea_results <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(
    geneList = gene_list,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    ont = ont,
    pvalueCutoff = pvalue_cutoff,
    keyType = key_type,
    nPermSimple = n_perm_simple,
    eps = eps
  )
  gsea_filtered <- clusterProfiler::simplify(
    gsea_results, 
    cutoff = 0.7, 
    by = "p.adjust", 
    select_fun = min
  )
    return(gsea_filtered)
}
```

```{r all CC pre HIIT}
####################### FIGURE 2D ###################################

compartments <- c("Cytosol", "Endoplasmic reticulum", "Golgi apparatus", "Nucleus", "Mitochondria",
                  "Endosome", "Lysosome", "Peroxisome", "Proteasome", "Ribosome")

fill_colors_pre <- c("LeanPre" = "white",
                     "ObesePre" = "white",
                     "T2DPre" = "white")

outline_colors_pre <- c("LeanPre" = "deepskyblue4",
                        "ObesePre" = "purple4",
                        "T2DPre" = "maroon3")

# Store plots and stats
plots_list <- list()
anova_results_list <- list()
tukey_results_list <- list()

# Loop through compartments
for (compartment in compartments) {

  # Get proteins belonging to the compartment
  compartment_proteins <- uniprot_keywords %>%
    filter(str_detect(keywords, regex(compartment, ignore_case = TRUE)))

  unique_gene_names <- unique(unlist(strsplit(as.character(compartment_proteins$gene_names), " ")))
  matching_rows <- intersect(rownames(raw_samples_basal), unique_gene_names)

  compartment_data <- raw_samples_basal %>%
    filter(rownames(raw_samples_basal) %in% matching_rows)

  # Normalize by total abundance
  summed_abundance_per_sample <- colSums(compartment_data, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_abundance_per_sample <- colSums(raw_samples_basal, na.rm = TRUE)
  normalized_abundance <- (summed_abundance_per_sample / total_abundance_per_sample) * 100

  # Build dataframe with metadata
  normalized_data <- data.frame(
    Sample = names(normalized_abundance),
    NormalizedAbundance = normalized_abundance
  )

  normalized_data$GroupTimepoint <- Rename_basal$GroupTimepoint[match(normalized_data$Sample, Rename_basal$Sample_ID)]

  # Filter to Pre only
  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    filter(GroupTimepoint %in% c("LeanPre", "ObesePre", "T2DPre"))

  normalized_data$GroupTimepoint <- factor(normalized_data$GroupTimepoint,
                                           levels = c("LeanPre", "ObesePre", "T2DPre"))

  # --- Boxplot ---
  plot <- ggplot(normalized_data, aes(x = GroupTimepoint, y = NormalizedAbundance,
                                      fill = GroupTimepoint, color = GroupTimepoint)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, size = 0.3, width = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors_pre) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outline_colors_pre) +
    labs(title = paste("Normalized", compartment, "Protein Abundance - Pre"),
         x = "Group (Pre)",
         y = "% of Total Proteome") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
    )

  plots_list[[compartment]] <- plot

  # --- Stats: ANOVA + Tukey ---
  anova_result <- aov(NormalizedAbundance ~ GroupTimepoint, data = normalized_data)
  anova_results_list[[compartment]] <- summary(anova_result)

  tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
  tukey_results_list[[compartment]] <- tukey_result

  # Print significant Tukey results (optional)
  print(paste("Tukey HSD results for", compartment))
  print(tukey_result)
}

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_list, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Normalized Protein Abundance Across Compartments - Pre Timepoints")
```

```{r Mvalue correlated to HIIT-logFC }
stopifnot(all(clin_filt_pre$Sample_ID == colnames(proteome_dataset_basal_pre)))

#  Mvalue and proteomics data
cor_data_pre <- cbind(
  Mvalue = clin_filt_pre$Mvalue,
  t(proteome_dataset_basal_pre)
)

# loop pearson correlation
results_pre <- list()
row_index <- 1

for (i in 2:ncol(cor_data_pre)) {
  Protein <- colnames(cor_data_pre)[i]

  if (sum(!is.na(cor_data_pre[, 1]) & !is.na(cor_data_pre[, i])) < 10) next

  test <- cor.test(
    x = cor_data_pre[, 1],  # M-value
    y = cor_data_pre[, i],  # Proteinintensity
    method = "pearson",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )

  results_pre[[row_index]] <- c(
    coefficient = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value,
    Protein = Protein
  )
  row_index <- row_index + 1
}

cor_pre_df$p_value <- as.numeric(cor_pre_df$p_value)
cor_pre_df$adjusted_pval <- p.adjust(cor_pre_df$p_value, method = "BH")
```

```{r Overrepresented GWAS traits}


#### load donwloaded GWAS data, eg:
# GWAS <- read.delim(here::here("data-raw/gwas_catalog_v1.0-associations_e112_r2024-05-20.tsv"), header = TRUE, quote = "")

# background: all proteins in proteomics dataset
all_proteins <- unique(Proteome_training$Protein)

# foreground: significantly training-regulated proteins
sig_proteins <- unique(Proteome_training$Protein[Proteome_training$adj.P.Val < 0.05])

enrichment_results <- list()

## store protein names with trait
# loop through each unique GWAS trait
for (trait in unique(GWAS$DISEASE.TRAIT)) {
    gwas_trait <- subset(GWAS, DISEASE.TRAIT == trait)
    reported <- unlist(strsplit(gwas_trait$REPORTED.GENE.S., ","))
    mapped <- unlist(strsplit(gwas_trait$MAPPED_GENE, ","))
    trait_genes <- unique(trimws(c(reported, mapped)))

    overlapping_proteins <- intersect(sig_proteins, trait_genes)

    overlap <- length(overlapping_proteins)
    not_in_sig <- length(setdiff(trait_genes, sig_proteins))
    in_sig_not_in_trait <- length(setdiff(sig_proteins, trait_genes))
    rest <- length(setdiff(all_proteins, union(sig_proteins, trait_genes)))

    contingency <- matrix(c(overlap, not_in_sig, in_sig_not_in_trait, rest), nrow = 2)
    fisher <- fisher.test(contingency)

    enrichment_results[[trait]] <- data.frame(
        Trait = trait,
        Overlap = overlap,
        p.value = fisher$p.value,
        OddsRatio = fisher$estimate,
        Proteins = paste(overlapping_proteins, collapse = ";")  
    )
}

enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, enrichment_results)

# adj p-values
enrichment_df$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(enrichment_df$p.value, method = "BH")
enrichment_df <- enrichment_df[order(enrichment_df$adj.p.value), ]

enrichment_df_filter <- enrichment_df %>%
    filter(adj.p.value < 0.05 & Overlap >= 10) 


protein_trait_map <- enrichment_df %>%
    filter(adj.p.value < 0.05 & Overlap >= 10) %>%
    separate_rows(Proteins, sep = ";")


sig_traits <- subset(enrichment_df, adj.p.value < 0.05) # 1033


############################# FIGURE 3G ##############################

top_n <- 20  # adjust as needed
ggplot(head(enrichment_df, top_n), aes(x = reorder(Trait, -log10(adj.p.value)), y = -log10(adj.p.value))) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top Enriched GWAS Traits (Proteome)",
         x = "GWAS Trait",
         y = "-log10(adj p-value)") +
    theme_minimal()


# Filter and sort by adjusted p-value and filter for at least xx proteins
top_traits <- enrichment_df[enrichment_df$adj.p.value < 0.05 & enrichment_df$Overlap > 30, ]
top_traits <- head(top_traits[order(top_traits$adj.p.value), ], 20)

plot <- ggplot(top_traits, aes(x = reorder(Trait, -log10(adj.p.value)),
                        y = -log10(adj.p.value),
                        size = Overlap)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Overrepresented GWAS Traits
         in Training regulated proteins",
         x = "Trait",
         y = "-log10(adj p-value)",
         size = "Number of regulated proteins
    associated with Trait (> 30)") +
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
plot

plot <- ggplot(top_traits, aes(x = reorder(Trait, -log10(adj.p.value)),
                               y = -log10(adj.p.value),
                               size = Overlap,
                               color = Overlap)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Overrepresented GWAS Traits\nin Training regulated proteins",
         x = "Trait",
         y = "-log10(adj p-value)",
         size = "Number of regulated proteins\nassociated with Trait (> 30)") +
```

```{r PRKAG2 Peptide level analysis}
log2_PRKAG2$EG.PrecursorId <- rownames(log2_PRKAG2)

# Step 3: Join stripped sequences
log2_PRKAG2 <- log2_PRKAG2 %>%
  left_join(
    peptides %>% dplyr::select(EG.PrecursorId, PEP.StrippedSequence),
    by = "EG.PrecursorId"

# Step 4: Ensure numeric sample columns (replace 5:11 with your correct range)
sample_cols <- colnames(log2)[1:163]
log2_PRKAG2[sample_cols] <- lapply(log2_PRKAG2[sample_cols], as.numeric)

# Step 5: Collapse by stripped sequence
log2_PRKAG2_collapsed <- log2_PRKAG2 %>%
  group_by(PEP.StrippedSequence) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# Step 6: Set rownames
log2_PRKAG2_matrix <- as.data.frame(log2_PRKAG2_collapsed)
rownames(log2_PRKAG2_matrix) <- log2_PRKAG2_matrix$PEP.StrippedSequence
log2_PRKAG2_matrix$PEP.StrippedSequence <- NULL



################################## FIGURE 6C #############################################

# 1. Convert collapsed matrix to long format
data_long <- log2_PRKAG2_matrix %>%
  rownames_to_column("Peptide") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Peptide, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "log2_expression")

# 2. Join with metadata to get Timepoint info

  group_by(Peptide) %>%
```
